Name: Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram
Summary: Jehosheba, daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, stole the baby Joash from among the king's sons being slain and hid him with his nurse in the temple six years.
KeyStory: Jehosheba hides baby Joash from Athaliah.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Judah; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Joash, King of Judah; Jehoiada, High Priest
LifeLesson: One woman's courage kept David's lamp burning through Athaliah's purge.
